info.syllabusName: Quản trị ẩm thực (Food and Beverage Management)
info.description:
The subject covers topics related to the different types of culinary activities and their management aspects from the formation of the business idea to the feasibility analysis and the development of the business plan. complete business. These aspects cover the financial, marketing, personnel, product and service elements, as well as the technological factor in typical business operations in restaurants;

Other content includes the development and planning of menus, pricing, procurement plans, storage, processing and service, and the factors affecting the food business.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Student understand and express basic and advanced knowledge about food business, distinguish between different establishments dealing in food and beverage; Remembers and evaluates the nature, characteristics and links between different aspects of food-related management; Link this subject knowledge with other subjects of Hospitality Management.

Students have the ability to analyze different food business activities; Able to plan new food business ideas, design food menu items, etablish work processes for specific food establishments; set up control system for food business; systems and technology for catering; Ensuring quality of service as well as systems related to marketing, personnel, and finance.

Learners are able to analyze and identify management systems applied to different food businesses; be creative in how to deal flexibly with specific situations; It is possible to set up operational procedures and management methods in line with the different types of catering business; Ability to self-adjust business ideas and management systems flexibly with each specific situation.

Learners have a clear understanding of the professional ethics of the service sector, namely the food service industry; love the job and the spirit of serving the society; Have behavior, attitudes and professional service spirit in the industry.
